mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has risen in three of the last four weekly readings, climbing from +4.9 to +9.3 percent above baseline, which shows household trips are being substituted back into the home; that substitution removes discretionary retail-and-recreation outings, so RETAIL_REC stays below its last-28-day mean through the next four weeks.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5 percent of baseline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has fallen to -8.7 percent of baseline, its first sustained break below -5, which marks the point where multi-stop trip chains are abandoned; retail-and-recreation visits sit downstream of those chains, so RETAIL_REC falls further within two weeks of the crossing.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -5.0 percent of baseline (printed -8.7 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from +3.3 at t-3w to -8.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher two weeks after a TRANSIT print below -5 percent of baseline than it was in the week of the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays above +45 and RESIDENTIAL above +8 in the same week, households are in a defensive stockpiling-and-stay-home mode; essential trips get batched into single grocery runs and mall visits are skipped, so retail-and-recreation declines over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM >= +45 and RESIDENTIAL >= +8 in the same week (both true at t-0w)
failure_condition: In weeks where both thresholds hold simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is at or above its previous 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under the Omicron-era tightening regime now in force in Hong Kong, venue capacity caps and shortened trading hours mechanically remove retail-and-recreation visits; the policy ceiling binds before voluntary behaviour can offset it, keeping RETAIL_REC negative across the whole four-week window.
candidate_trigger: social-distancing restrictions are tightened after 2022-01-15 (dine-in and venue capacity caps announced)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not below its last-28-day mean while the tightened restriction regime remains in force.

mechanism_narrative: Hong Kong's Lunar New Year falls on 1 February 2022, so the two weeks after the decision point carry the annual pre-holiday gift and grocery spending peak; the seasonal lift in mall and restaurant traffic pulls RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: calendar position within 21 days before Lunar New Year (1 February 2022)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM held at 53.7, 49.9, 48.6, 48.9 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-28-day mean at any point during the 14 days before Lunar New Year.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS has dropped from -4.4 to -16.7 over four weekly means, a 12.3-point contraction in outdoor leisure trips; park visits and retail trips draw on the same discretionary outing budget, so the parks collapse predicts an immediate one-week-ahead fall in RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below -15 percent of baseline (printed -16.7 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 12.3 points between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: In the week following a PARKS print below -15 percent of baseline, RETAIL_REC is higher than in the week of the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen 17.0 points across the four weekly means to -13.3, an unusually deep four-week drawdown; when a four-week drawdown exceeds 15 points, trip suppression overshoots underlying demand and a partial rebound lifts the next-28-day mean above the last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below its last-28-day mean after a four-week drawdown larger than 15 points.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has whipsawed from -14.9 to +6.0 to -0.6 while TRANSIT sits at -8.7; that combination means office attendance is unstable and commuter-linked lunch and after-work retail spending is repeatedly cancelled, so RETAIL_REC falls again within one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week swing exceeds 10 points while TRANSIT is below -5 percent of baseline
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved -14.9, +6.0, -0.6 across the last three weekly means
failure_condition: One week after a WORKPLACES swing larger than 10 points with TRANSIT below -5, RETAIL_REC is higher than in the swing week.
